description:
### Bou 1.4.11

* Many more words: 131,884 real Latin spellings of Bengali words, 66,000 Bengali Wikipedia words and Bangladesh place names. Word accuracy on human-written Banglish sentences: 60.1% -> 67.4%; regional speech unchanged (81.7%)
* anek, bapare, mile now come out as অনেক, ব্যাপারে, মিলে
* AI mode: no more HTTP 400 when a Gemini model refuses the thinking setting

Supports Gboard 18.6.3.100 (arm64).
